description:
Configure Jitsi Meet to strictly require a display name for all users. 

1. Locate the Jitsi Meet web configuration file in `~/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/` (typically `config.js` or `interface_config.js`).
2. Edit the file to enable the `requireDisplayName` setting (set it to `true`).
3. Reload the browser and attempt to join a meeting to verify the policy.
4. Take a screenshot of the Pre-join screen showing the 'Join meeting' button is DISABLED when the name field is empty. Save this screenshot to `~/evidence_disabled_button.png`.
5. Finally, enter a name and successfully join the meeting.
